description: Only Malina is welcome. Everyone else, go away!
summary: In this project we have built an interactive web app that compares observations of the same sky region taken on different dates to make it easier for amateurs who doesn’t have prior knowledge in astronomy or coding to spot moving objects in the deep space. We are using level 2 infrared images from NASA’s SPHEREx mission that is available through NASA/IPAC IRSA in our project. SPHEREx use different detectors to capture different wavelengths and we have done deployed the facility to change the detector through our web app so users can observe the universe using different wavelengths.
details: We used Python programming language to write the code to process NASA SPHEREx images and implement the web app to interact with the user. In terms of Python packages, we mainly relied upon "astropy" to read FIT files, "numpy" to handle image arrays, "matplotlib" to display images, "Streamlit" to deploy the web app, "requests" to query the NASA/IPAC IRSA and download cutouts . The software consists of two Python scripts which are app.py and astronommy.py which are responsible of handling the Streamlit interface and handling the image processing aspect respectively.
